checks: OS MasterMap is the basis for HM Land Registry plans
urban title plans are broadly prepared at 1:1250
rural title plans are broadly prepared at 1:2500
mountain and moorland plans are broadly prepared at 1:10000
OS topographic mapping is not intended to represent legal property boundaries
a 1:1250 map line is roughly 0.3m wide on the ground
a 1:2500 map line is roughly 0.6m wide on the ground
scaled measurements from title plans or OS mapping are not supplied as exact measurements
enlarging mapping does not improve its original survey accuracy
copying reducing or enlarging a plan can distort accuracy
1:1250 relative error guide is below plus or minus 0.5m
1:2500 resurvey relative error guide is below plus or minus 1.0m
1:1250 absolute RMSE guide is below plus or minus 0.5m
1:2500 resurvey absolute RMSE guide is below plus or minus 1.1m
mapped physical features are a survey-time snapshot not a legal boundary assertion
closely spaced features can collapse to one mapped feature depending on capture scale
